chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, said:
"It is recommended for a man to go to his wife on the first night of the month of Ramadan, due to the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Permitted for you on the night of the fasting is intimacy with your wives."

key_terms.أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ: has been made lawful for you

ai.seo_question: Is marital intimacy allowed on the first night of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is recommended for a man to approach his wife on the first night of Ramadan, citing the Quranic permission for marital intimacy during the nights of fasting. It connects a legal recommendation to the verse establishing the permissibility of conjugal relations after the fast has ended at night.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2052 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"It is recommended for a man to go to his wife on the first night of the Month of Ramadan, based on the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty:
'It has been made lawful for you to be intimate with your wives during the night of fasting.' (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:187)
